servicio.descripcionMeta: Batch documentation, samples, formulation support and INVIMA/ICA regulatory guidance. This is how we support your raw material purchase.
servicio.heroTitulo1: Selling the kilo is the easy part.
servicio.heroTitulo2: Standing behind it is the craft.
servicio.heroTexto: Complete documentation, samples to validate and the technical judgment to choose well. This is what sits behind every item in the catalog.

servicios.texto: Every shipment can come with a technical data sheet, safety data sheet (SDS) and certificate of analysis for the batch. It's the foundation of your quality control and your traceability — always ask for them, no need to feel awkward.
Before scaling up a purchase, validate the material in your lab. We coordinate samples from the available batch so you can check performance, color, odor and compatibility in your real formula.
Not sure whether you need an O/W or W/O emulsifier? Looking for a replacement for a discontinued item? We'll guide you toward the right specialty for your application and process.

We guide you on the documentation typically required by INVIMA (cosmetics and food) and ICA (agriculture and veterinary) for your filings. Regulatory responsibility for the finished product lies with the registration holder, but we won't leave you alone with the paperwork.

The same raw material can arrive as flakes, beads or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch; packaging varies between sacks, boxes, jerrycans, drums and IBCs. We publish reference presentations and confirm the actual batch's before we invoice.
Shipments to the country's main cities with partner carriers and proper handling according to each product's classification. We coordinate partial or scheduled deliveries to fit your production plan.

servicio.docsTitulo: The three documents you should always ask for
servicio.docsTexto: It doesn't matter who you buy from: these documents are your backing for quality and traceability. With us they come up in the conversation, not in the fine print.

docs.d: Describes what the product is and its typical specifications: appearance, physicochemical parameters, storage conditions. It's your reference for knowing whether it fits your process.
Hazard, handling, PPE and transport information under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS). Required for your risk matrix and for shipping the product.
The results of the specific batch you receive, against the specification. It's the document that confirms what arrived at your warehouse is what you bought.

faqs.q: Why does the presentation say «depending on the manufacturer and batch»?
faqs.a: Because that's the reality of the market: a raw material like stearic acid can come as flakes, beads or powder depending on who makes it and on each batch. We'd rather tell you upfront and confirm the exact physical form of the available batch before you buy, instead of promising something the supply chain can change.

faqs.q: What are the minimum order quantities?
faqs.a: They depend on the product: some items sell from a 1 kg presentation and others by the full sack or drum. Message us on WhatsApp with the quantity you need and we'll confirm availability and minimums.

faqs.q: What documents come with the purchase?
faqs.a: Technical data sheet, safety data sheet (SDS) and certificate of analysis of the shipped batch, depending on the product. If your quality system requires additional documents, tell us in the quote request so we can validate them with the manufacturer.

The sales channel is WhatsApp: that's where you confirm your order and receive the PSE payment link to pay by debit from your bank. We can also arrange other methods with your advisor. Only pay links sent from our official number.
Yes. We ship nationwide through partner carriers. Delivery times depend on the city and the type of product; your advisor confirms the estimate along with the quote.

faqs.q: What if the raw material I need isn't in the catalog?
faqs.a: The published catalog is a selection of the fastest-moving items. If you need another raw material, another grade or another packaging, message us: we'll source it through our network of manufacturers and represented brands.

nosotros.descripcionMeta: Q'mical is a Colombian raw material distributor with one obsession: that what reaches your warehouse is exactly what we promised.
nosotros.heroTitulo: We started from a simple question: why is buying chemicals in Colombia so opaque?
historiaHtml: Q'mical is a distributor of raw materials for industry, based in Bogotá D.C. and operating nationwide. We serve formulators and production plants across eight industries: cosmetics, makeup, cleaning and disinfection, food and beverage, agriculture, veterinary, natural extracts and industrial chemistry.

The founding team comes from both sides of the counter: years buying ingredients for production plants and years selling them for distributors. That double life produced the diagnosis — this market has too much inventory and not enough information — and the recipe too: a transparent catalog, batch documentation and a real advisor on the other end of WhatsApp.

We're not Colombia's largest distributor and we're not trying to be. We'd rather be the one that answers first, the one that tells the truth about the batch presentation, and the one that finds you the hard-to-get item when nobody else picks up.
nosotros.principiosTexto: They're the reason a client who buys from us once tends to stay.

principios.titulo: Tell the truth about the batch
principios.texto: Physical form and specifications vary between manufacturers and batches. Our policy is to describe reference presentations and always confirm the actual technical data sheet before selling. We'd rather lose a sale than earn a complaint.
Whoever answers your WhatsApp knows the difference between an anionic and an amphoteric surfactant. If we don't know something, we check with the manufacturer — we don't improvise.
We quote fast because production doesn't wait, but every shipment leaves with its full documentation. Speed without paperwork isn't service, it's risk.
We work with international manufacturers and we also champion ingredients from Colombia and LATAM — cacao, sacha inchi, cupuazú — because the region's biodiversity is world-class raw material.

nosotros.entregamosTexto: We operate from {direccion}, shipping to the country's main cities through partner carriers, and we coordinate scheduled deliveries for plants running a production plan.
nosotros.compromisoHtml: Transparency commitment: no description on this site promises physical form, purity or guaranteed performance. Everything is confirmed with the batch's technical data sheet before the sale — that's how we avoid the complaints this sector knows all too well.
nosotros.ctaTitulo: Let's talk: your process deserves a good supplier
nosotros.ctaTexto: Tell us what you produce and what hurts about your current supply chain. That's our terrain.
